minor.issue: Still returns [] for Ayu by design (assigned-only), while for_order=true branch returns 4. Behavior is as documented in iteration_239 action item ('plain list stays assigned-only'); flagging only because other sales flows (collection worklist, credit-status) still use the broader own-order union — the asymmetry remains intentional per spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Add-evidence block gated on status in ['draft','submitted','approved','received','inspected'] but the just-created SRET-00001 has status 'pending_approval' (confirmed via GET /api/sales-returns). Result: m-return-evidence-closed renders with 'retur sudah diproses, bukti tidak bisa ditambah lagi' and m-return-camera button is NOT shown, so uploading a 2nd photo via m-return-camera is impossible for the common post-submit state. Spec explicitly requires adding one more photo via m-return-camera after save.

issues: Playwright-automation note (non-user-facing): the 'mobile-more-returns' row in the Lainnya grid can sit under the fixed bottom tabbar (m-tabbar) after section expansion — real-tap works, but scripted click with force=True on viewport 390x844 was intercepted and switched to tab=cart. Workaround used in tests: element.click() via JS. Consider adding bottom padding (pb-safe + tabbar height) to the Lainnya scroll container so no row overlaps the tabbar.

action_items: FIX MobileReturns.jsx L40 allowed-status list: add 'pending_approval' (and probably 'picked'/'submitted' aliases that the backend actually emits). Consider adding pb-32 (or safe-area padding) to the Lainnya scroll container so the last menu row (Retur Penjualan when sections expand) doesn't visually sit under the bottom tabbar on 390x844 viewports.

context_for_next_testing_agent: (1) The scripted Playwright click on [data-testid='mobile-more-returns'] can be intercepted by the bottom tabbar even with force=True on 390x844 — use `await page.evaluate("()=>document.querySelector(selector)?.click()")` to JS-click any Lainnya grid row that sits near the viewport bottom (same for mobile-more-special when sections expand). (2) return-order-select is a shadcn combobox (role=combobox, not native select); open with click then click [role='option']. (3) After save, SRET goes to status 'pending_approval' which currently hides m-return-camera (frontend bug — status whitelist missing 'pending_approval'). (4) od-customer / od-delivery are cmdk/Popover — use click-open then click option/day (not fill). (5) The customer-list fix uses /api/customers?for_order=true&with_credit=false — do NOT retest the plain /api/customers for sales (it will remain []). (6) m-od-ref-input works for adding references on the detail page even for status=pending_approval (verified).
